The UM3783 is ±86V fault-protected, half-duplex, RS-485 transceiver operating on a single 3V to
5.5V supply voltage. Bus interface pins are protected against overvoltage conditions during all
modes of operation ensuring robust communication in rugged industrial environments.
Extended ±25V input common-mode range guarantees reliable data communication over longer
cable run lengths and/or in the presence of large ground loop voltages. Enhanced 250mV receiver
hysteresis ensures high noise rejection. In addition, the receiver fail-safe feature guarantees a logic
high when the inputs are open or shorted together.
The UM3783 is available in SOP8 and MSOP8 packages for space-constrained applications. The
device is characterized over ambient free-air temperatures from -40°C to 125°C.
